content: Pure C# core in Unity (gamedev.center headless .NET tests, lazlo.dev object types, community guides): keep domain logic free of UnityEngine types so it runs in plain .NET tests 10x faster; 'pure' code often leaks Vector3/Mathf/Debug.Log/Time.deltaTime and breaks headless; ScriptableObjects are data-only and mutating them at runtime persists in the editor; use asmdef boundaries and a linked-file .csproj for headless.
